paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.13% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+1.02%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-0.38%). Brent crude changed +1.35% to 110.26. Gold changed -0.24% to 4,132.5. Bitcoin changed +1.09% to 82,749.1172. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.117%, a relative move of -0.37%. Among the firms tracked, Glencore (-3.31%) and Jefferies (+3.23%) moved the most.
